# Job posting

- **Saved:** 2026-10-12 by Factwright (feed), word for word

## Senior Product Manager, Growth

Fernway helps families book vacation homes they’ll love. We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead growth for our guest app.

## What you’ll do
- Own the growth roadmap for guest acquisition and retention
- Run A/B testing with data science and engineering, and decide what ships
- Partner with marketing on lifecycle and email marketing
- Use Amplitude and SQL to find where guests drop off

## What you bring
- 5+ years of product management in consumer marketplaces
- A track record with experimentation and pricing
- Fluency in SQL and product analytics
- Experience writing OKRs and setting KPIs
- Strong stakeholder management across design, engineering and marketing

## Nice to have
- Experience with Figma and user research
- Familiarity with Looker or Tableau
- Background in mobile development or iOS apps

## Benefits
- Health, dental and vision
- Flexible PTO
